usage: Used in maths for the operation or result of cubing, as in power of 3: 立方.
Common in school math, science, and geometry; it sounds formal and standard, not casual slang.
Can pair with measure words or numbers when talking about volume, e.g. a cube-shaped object or cubic units.
For learners: 立方 is often linked to 平方 (square) and 次方 (power), so it usually appears in lessons about exponents and measurement.
